newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cheuvreux sets buy rating on PSA.
newsitem.headline: Cheuvreux sets buy rating on PSA.

text.p: Brokerage Cheuvreux de Virieu raised its rating on PSA Peugeot Citroen stock on Friday to buy from sell and boosted its 1997 and 1998 earnings forecasts, market sources said.
They said Cheuvreux expects the car company to show a profit this year of 12 francs per share, compared with a previous estimate for a seven franc loss.

For 1998, it expects EPS of 34 francs, up from 22 francs. The improved outlook reflects positive currency movements, notably sterling's rise, and strong sales volumes in light commercial vehicles and car exports outside Europe.
Shares in PSA Peugeot Citroen were up 4.48 percent at 0910 GMT at a year high of 677 francs, where they were bumping into technical resistance.

The French car sector has benefitted from positive recommendations in the past two weeks and a shift in expectations, with the market starting to expect both Peugeot and Renault to make profits this year.
Renault, up 1.23 percent at 181.50 francs, hit a year high on Wednesday.
